stem: Which sentence shows that the narrator is aware of the feelings of others?

options.label: F
options.text: It doesn’t seem to be as strong, though, and the first turtle is putting an increasing amount of distance between them.

options.label: G
options.text: The baby turtle seems to be taking a break from his attempts to free himself from the nest.

options.label: H
options.text: We hurry back to the nest, where a few other beachwalkers have been drawn in as well.

options.label: J
options.text: I can tell her mind is on my little brother, Charlie.
